name: deepwiki
description: DeepWiki MCP server with API key support — AI-generated documentation and Q&A about any GitHub repository.

api_key.description: Optional DeepWiki API key, sent as the Authorization: Bearer header. Leave empty for anonymous access (public repositories only). Create one at https://app.devin.ai/settings/api-keys.

org_id.description: Optional Devin organization id, sent as the X-Org-Id header. Needed for private repositories and for the org-wide devin_* tools.
